definition_en: the liquid from fruit or plants, or electric power in informal speech

senses.title: Electric power, in informal speech
senses.example: The battery has no juice left.
senses.why: Running machines need power the way bodies need liquid, so juice became slang for electricity.
senses.whyCN: 机器运转需要动力，正如身体需要液体，juice 就成了电的口语说法。

definition_en: a very short time ago, fair and right, or only
core_image: 钟表的秒针刚跳过整点，门口的人推门进来
scene: 钟表的秒针刚跳过整点，门口的人推门进来。The bus has just left.
sceneCN: 这里 just 是「刚刚」（第 01 个义项）；句意是公交车刚刚开走。

senses.title: A very short time ago
senses.example: The bus has just left.
senses.why: Just comes from Latin justus, 'lawful', through French; the time sense grew from 'exactly at that point'.
senses.whyCN: just 经法语来自拉丁语 justus「合法的」；表示时间的义项由「正好在那一点」发展而来。

senses.title: Fair and right
senses.example: The judge made a just decision.
senses.exampleCN: 法官作出了公正的裁决。
senses.why: The oldest sense is legal and moral: something just follows the law and treats people rightly.
senses.whyCN: 最古老的义项是法律与道德上的：just 的事物合乎法律、公平待人。

senses.title: Only, or exactly
senses.example: It costs just five yuan.
senses.why: Because something just reaches a limit and no more, the word came to mean only or exactly.
senses.whyCN: 因为某物正好达到某个界限而不再多，这个词就表示「只」或「正好」。

senses.example: She was the last to finish the race.

senses.whyCN: 因为最近发生的事也就是此刻之前的那一件，last 就表示上一个的。

senses.title: To continue for a time
senses.example: The film lasts two hours.
senses.why: The verb last is a separate Old English word, læstan, meaning to continue or endure.
senses.whyCN: 动词 last 是另一个古英语词 læstan，意为持续、忍受。
